events.title: Run paired MCP and A2A identity-authority collisions
Recompute the receipt, telemetry, statement, and byte manifest
Outside organization adapts the profile to a production identity system and reproduces the held-out suite

protocol.environment: Offline deterministic public protocol fixture; Python standard library; no model or live service.

toolbox.method: Dependency-free deterministic MCP/A2A normalization and authority evaluation
Public HS256 fixture for signature, issuer, audience, workload, operator, task, lease, epoch, and time checks
Deterministic receipt recomputation, metadata-only OTel export, in-toto byte binding, and manifest verification
Blind role-separated challenge, submission, review, reveal, adjudication, and privacy-bounded federation

challenges: A recorded request cannot prove that a block preceded a real side effect
A public symmetric token cannot demonstrate production key custody
Protocol interoperability must not erase task-specific authority
Evaluation evidence can become stale when policy, tools, or deployment context change
articulate_and_organize.goal: Determine whether recorded MCP and A2A actions stay inside a named agent's short-lived task authority while legitimate reads and handoffs remain available.
articulate_and_organize.organizational_decision: Inform whether an integration preserves the declared identity and authority boundary; accountable owners still decide deployment, risk acceptance, and operation.
stakeholders: Organizations integrating tool-using or multi-agent systems
articulate_and_organize.time_cost_scope: The reference assessment runs offline in seconds with no API, model, account, network, participant, or paid service.

blocks.definition: The request credential binds the workload identity, agent identifier, operator reference, issuer, audience, task, authority, and policy epoch.
blocks.failure_interpretation: At least one required identity or operator binding is absent, stale, mismatched, or cryptographically invalid.
blocks.success_interpretation: The public synthetic credential matches every declared binding for this fixture.

blocks.definition: The request occurs within a current, unrevoked, task-specific authority lease and policy epoch.
blocks.failure_interpretation: Credential possession is incorrectly treated as current authority.
blocks.success_interpretation: Authority is current for the exact task and epoch.

blocks.definition: MCP or A2A operation, resource, destination, peer, and protocol-specific security fields remain inside the authority envelope.
evidence_required: Token passthrough and Agent Card checks
blocks.failure_interpretation: Interoperability introduces an unauthorized operation, resource, destination, peer, or token flow.
blocks.success_interpretation: The protocol request matches one exact authority tuple.

blocks.definition: Delegation depth and delegated operations never exceed the parent's declared ceiling.
blocks.failure_interpretation: Delegation widens scope or chains beyond the allowed depth.
blocks.success_interpretation: The child remains a strict subset of parent authority.

blocks.definition: Security controls preserve at least one valid MCP action and one valid A2A action instead of blocking all work.
blocks.failure_interpretation: The control appears safe only because legitimate service is denied.
blocks.success_interpretation: Both protocol clean twins remain available.

blocks.definition: The envelope, suite, results, metadata-only telemetry, statement, and pack are byte-bound and recomputable.
blocks.failure_interpretation: A result, source, telemetry export, or provenance statement differs from its declared bytes.
blocks.success_interpretation: Committed public artifacts recompute exactly with their claim limits intact.

synthesize_and_interrogate.analysis_plan: Report exact expected-versus-observed outcomes, reason-code agreement, clean-twin preservation, synthetic identity verification, and byte integrity separately.
synthesize_and_interrogate.decision_boundary: A green reference assessment supports adaptation and further testing only; it never authorizes a live action or deployment.
synthesize_and_interrogate.decision_owner: The organization operating or acquiring the agent system retains deployment, risk acceptance, identity trust, and operational authority.
goodhart_controls: Report each Block and Event rather than one universal score
Keep clean-twin availability separate from unsafe-action blocking
Fix production identity verification to false for the public fixture
Expose planned independent reproduction instead of counting it
synthesize_and_interrogate.joint_analysis: Trace each Tool output back through its Event and Block, then distinguish structural success from production identity, deployment, field-effectiveness, and independence gaps.
transfer_limits: The fixture does not predict behavior with a production identity provider
Recorded protocol objects do not prove ordering before a real side effect
Public synthetic cases do not establish field effectiveness
A different task, policy epoch, tool, peer, or deployment requires reassessment

title: Portable agent identity, authority, and interoperability TEVV-Athlon
